info.title: etwutils
info.description: Cross-tooling CLI for the Nefarius.Utilities.ETW library: realtime ETW capture and PDB/WPP inspection, streaming NDJSON to stdout.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: etwutils — ETW event decoder and offline trace parser. Stream realtime events or decode .etl files as NDJSON on stdout.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: realtime
commands.description: Attach to a realtime ETW session, enable a provider, and stream decoded events on stdout.

options.name: --keywords
options.description: Match-any keyword mask. Accepts hex (0xABCD) or decimal. Default: all keywords. [default: 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF]

options.name: --match-all-keywords
options.description: Match-all keyword mask. Accepts hex (0xABCD) or decimal. Default: disabled (0). [default: 0]

options.name: --level
options.description: Maximum event severity level to capture. [default: Verbose]

options.name: --session-name
options.description: ETW session name. Defaults to NefariusEtwCli-<pid>. [default: NefariusEtwCli-2808]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Path to a PDB file, TMF file, directory (searched recursively), or a glob pattern (e.g. C:\Symbols\*.pdb). Repeat the flag for multiple paths.

options.name: --buffer-size-kb
options.description: ETW buffer size in kilobytes per buffer. [default: 64]

options.name: --flush-seconds
options.description: How often (in seconds) the session flushes in-flight buffers. [default: 1]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'ndjson' (default) streams one JSON object per line; 'plain' emits tab-separated Timestamp/Provider/Level/Message columns. [default: ndjson]

options.name: --color
options.description: Colorize the Level column in plain mode. 'auto' (default) enables color when stdout is a TTY and NO_COLOR is unset; 'always' forces color; 'never' disables it. [default: auto]

options.name: --columns
options.description: Comma-separated column tokens for plain output. Known tokens: Timestamp, Provider, ProviderGuid, Level, LevelNumber, Message, EventName, EventId, Pid, Tid, Cpu, ActivityId, RelatedActivityId, Function, Component, SubComponent, Flags. Default: Timestamp,Provider,Level,Message. Ignored when --format is not plain.

options.name: --header
options.description: Emit a TSV header line as the first output line (plain mode only). Ignored when --format is not plain. [default: False]

options.name: --filter
options.description: DynamicExpresso predicate; events for which the expression returns false are skipped (plain mode only). Available identifiers: Timestamp, Provider, ProviderGuid, Level, LevelNumber, Message, EventName, EventId, Pid, Tid, Cpu, ActivityId, RelatedActivityId, Function, Component, SubComponent, Flags. Example: Provider != "Foo" && Message.StartsWith("Bar"). Ignored when --format is not plain.

arguments.name: PROVIDER_GUID
arguments.description: One or more ETW provider GUIDs to enable (e.g. {12345678-...}). When omitted, provider GUIDs are auto-derived from any PDB files passed to --symbols. All providers share the same keyword/level filters.

commands.name: inspect-pdb
commands.description: Parse one or more PDB files and list the WPP provider GUIDs (control GUIDs) embedded in them via TMC: annotations. No ETW session is created. Output goes to stdout; status messages go to stderr.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'plain' (default) or 'ndjson'. [default: plain]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: One or more paths to .pdb files, directories (searched for *.pdb), or glob patterns (e.g. C:\Symbols\*.pdb). TMF files are ignored as they do not contain WPP control GUID information.

commands.name: parse
commands.description: Decode one or more offline .etl files and emit events as NDJSON (or plain TSV) to stdout (events time-merged across all inputs) or to per-file output in a target directory (--out-dir). WPP symbols are resolved automatically when --symbols-search or --symbol-server is supplied.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Write each input .etl to an equally-named file (e.g. trace.etl → trace.ndjson or trace.tsv) in this directory instead of streaming all events merged to stdout.

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Path to a PDB file, TMF file, directory (searched recursively), or a glob pattern. Repeat the flag for multiple paths. These are loaded unconditionally.

options.name: --symbols-search
options.description: Directories or glob patterns searched for PDBs that the trace actually references. Resolved via a pre-scan of the .etl files. Repeat for multiple paths.

options.name: --symbol-server
options.description: Microsoft-style symbol store root URL (e.g. https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols or https://symbols.nefarius.at/download/symbols). Unresolved PDBs are downloaded and cached atomically.

options.name: --symbol-cache
options.description: Local symstore-layout cache directory. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Nefarius\etwutils\symcache. Falls back to _NT_SYMBOL_PATH when this flag and --symbol-server are both absent.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: 'ndjson' (default) streams one JSON object per line; 'plain' emits tab-separated Timestamp/Provider/Level/Message columns. [default: ndjson]

options.name: --color
options.description: Colorize the Level column in plain stdout mode. 'auto' (default) enables color when stdout is a TTY and NO_COLOR is unset; 'always' forces color; 'never' disables it. Ignored in per-file (--out-dir) mode. [default: auto]

options.name: --preserve-raw-timestamps
options.description: Apply PROCESS_TRACE_MODE_RAW_TIMESTAMP when processing the trace. [default: False]

options.name: --columns
options.description: Comma-separated column tokens for plain output. Known tokens: Timestamp, Provider, ProviderGuid, Level, LevelNumber, Message, EventName, EventId, Pid, Tid, Cpu, ActivityId, RelatedActivityId, Function, Component, SubComponent, Flags. Default: Timestamp,Provider,Level,Message. Ignored when --format is not plain.

options.name: --header
options.description: Emit a TSV header line as the first output line (plain mode only). Ignored when --format is not plain. [default: False]

options.name: --filter
options.description: DynamicExpresso predicate; events for which the expression returns false are skipped (plain mode only). Available identifiers: Timestamp, Provider, ProviderGuid, Level, LevelNumber, Message, EventName, EventId, Pid, Tid, Cpu, ActivityId, RelatedActivityId, Function, Component, SubComponent, Flags. Example: Provider != "Foo" && Message.StartsWith("Bar"). Ignored when --format is not plain.

arguments.name: ETL_PATH
arguments.description: One or more .etl files, directories (top-level *.etl), or glob patterns (e.g. C:\Traces\*.etl). Repeat for multiple paths.
